According to vehicle registration data, electric two-wheelers remained the largest segment of India's EV market, with approximately 1.40 million electric two-wheelers registered during FY 2025-26 , representing a growth of approximately 21.8% over the previous financial year.
Growth & demand: For the financial year ended 31 March 2026, the Company recorded revenue from operations of ₹27,683.83 lakhs, as compared to ₹17,859.45 lakhs in the previous financial year, registering a growth of approximately 70.73%.

The Company's performance reflects the continued growth in demand for electric mobility solutions and the Company's efforts towards strengthening its manufacturing capabilities, product portfolio, distribution network and market presence.
Electric four-wheeler registrations also recorded significant growth, increasing by approximately 91.3% year-on-year to 193,633 units during the year.
Margins & costs: The Company's profitability may be affected by fluctuations in raw material prices, battery and component costs, competitive pricing pressures, changes in government policies and incentives relating to electric vehicles, supply-chain conditions, technological developments and the overall pace of adoption of electric mobility.
